opening_message: I bought the USB hub in ORD-7217, but I want to exchange it for the Atlas 9-in-1 USB-C Hub I found elsewhere. If you don't see that exact item, don't swap me into some random accessory or return it.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to whether ORD-7217's 7-Port USB-C Hub can be exchanged for the exact Atlas 9-in-1 USB-C Hub; do not ask for any other replacement or remedy.
Provide the order ID, current USB hub, and exact requested Atlas 9-in-1 USB-C Hub when asked or when needed to correct the scope.
Do not volunteer catalog, stock, policy, refund, or return eligibility facts; ask the agent to check those records if needed.

If the agent proposes a phone case, generic accessory, different hub, refund, return, cancellation, warranty claim, store credit, or other workaround, push back once and ask only whether the exact Atlas exchange is possible.
Accept a clear explanation that the exact Atlas 9-in-1 replacement is not available or resolvable in this task catalog and that the order will be left unchanged.
End only after the agent clearly gives that no-mutation explanation and does not process a substitute, return, refund, cancellation, warranty claim, store credit, or exchange.
